references.text: For whoever has, to him more will be given, and he will have abundance; but from the one who does not have, even what he thinks he has will be taken away.
Pay attention then to how you listen. For whoever has, to him more will be given; and from the one who does not have, even what he seems to have will be taken away.
One gives freely yet grows all the richer; another withholds what is right but comes only to poverty.
One person scatters and gains still more; another holds back more than is right, but it leads only to want.
